ai_summary: Paushak Limited's 53rd Annual General Meeting, held remotely on July 30, 2026, successfully addressed routine business including the adoption of FY2025-26 financial statements, dividend declaration, and director re-appointment. Key special resolutions involved approving a commission for Non-Executive Director Mr. Udit Amin and ratifying the Cost Auditor's remuneration, which will impact the company's financial allocations. There are no apparent red flags within these standard AGM proceedings, with voting results expected by August 1, 2026.
